hypothesis: A CX13 or CX14 'suspend additions' warning can be applied to an opening signal of any rule on that side, though the texts name only their own position.
exact_claim: The page (inference 1): 'applying a CX13/CX14 warning to an opening signal of any rule on that side. The texts name the position they warn on, not other rules.' This is the step condition 1 takes beyond the CX13 and CX14 texts.
scope: Condition 1 (decider_v1/condition-1): any rule's opening signal, on the side of a standing CX13 or CX14 warning. The page names no trade days and no dates; it says only that the decider was written with 'these trade days' already studied.
boundaries: Does not cover whether the warning is still standing (condition 1) or any outcome. No source text says the warning reaches other rules; that is why it is an inference.
inference_reason: Inferred from CX13 and CX14's own texts: each arms on an open paper position of one direction and says to suspend additions to that position; the texts name no other rule's signal.
mechanism: A warning to stop adding to a direction can be read as about the direction (any further opening that way) or about the one position. The decider takes the first reading: a new opening on that side adds to the same exposure.
alternatives: The texts' 'the upward position' is one open paper position; a new signal of another rule opens its own trade, which the warning does not name.
CX13 and CX14 arm only when a position of the same trade is open, so a signal when none is open may sit outside what they warn on.

falsifiers.observation: A rule or platform text that treats each rule's trade as separate exposure, or that limits 'additions' to the trade that armed the warning.
falsifiers.record: paper_platform/rules CX13, CX14 and any shared-rules text at the platform commit

falsifiers.observation: A journaled run where a skip under [suspended-additions] was applied to a rule that was not the one that raised the warning and the warned trade's row shows no open position.
falsifiers.record: decision skip reasons and journal rows of the run

rests_on.quote: An upward paper position is open and dipole is negative.
Suspend additions to the upward position.
A downward paper position is open and dipole is positive.
Suspend additions to the downward position.
